display_title: All I Need Is the Duke's Child
description:
*“If I could go back in time, I wouldn’t have fallen in love with him.”*

After returning to the past, her second marriage to her ex-husband was solely for the sake of her child. Unlike her previous life, where she had yearned for love, this second life—gained as if by a miracle— led her to choose marriage to him with the single-minded determination to reunite with her child.

 *“Just keep up the pretense of our marriage for exactly one year.”*

The price she paid was to cooperate with him in uncovering the secret behind the incident from ten years ago, just as he wished. She thought they were just a couple in name only, bound by that contract… 

 *“We don’t necessarily have to spend our wedding night together—”

“I want to.”*

He was different from her past life.

(Source: Naver, translated)
